shared: Game UI screen for VOXEL BLITZ, a voxel arena shooter. Dark slate panels (#0d151c to #1a2632), thin 1px steel borders, amber accent #ffb347 with cyan secondary #72e6ff, condensed uppercase kickers in a monospaced face, bold sans-serif names, no rounded pills, no glassmorphism. One dialog titled ARMORY with a sticky 56px header (brand VOXEL BLITZ, tabs LOADOUT / WEAPONS / PROGRESS / MASTERY, small MUSIC slider, BACK button) and a 64px career strip (callsign art, GUEST PLAYER, LEVEL 12 / Veteran, XP bar with '1,300 XP TO LEVEL 13', record PVP KILLS / WINS / ALL KILLS / MATCHES, SAVE YOUR CAREER). Right column: a 400px inspector with a 16:10 3D stage, kicker, 28px name, 'WHO SEES IT:' line, one-sentence detail, state glyph plus word, requirement bars and one primary action. Locked items use dashed borders and a lock glyph at full contrast, never faded. No currency, no prices, no store words. All numbers illustrative.
